note: The entry follows Holmgren's 1910 original description (soldier and worker), published as Eutermes tipuanicus n. sp. The original is a library OCR text of a BHL scan (Zenodo/Plazi mirror); the German original description was read line by line; figures that the OCR scrambled beyond confirmation are not listed.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 4—4.5 mm; head length 1.75 mm (the head width is scrambled by the OCR and not listed). Very similar to Eutermes pluriarticulatus, of about the same colour, pilosity and size, but the nasus relatively thicker. Frontal outline straight with a weak elevation at the base of the nasus; the upper edge of the nasus and the back of the head on the same plane. Antennae probably 13-segmented: basal segment shorter than the sum of the next two; segment 3 nearly twice as long as segment 2, contracted at the base and thick at the tip; segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body length 6 mm (head length and head width scrambled by the OCR and not listed). Head yellowish brown; cephalic sutures, clypeus, labrum, base of the mandibles, region around the antennae, antennae and the rest of the body white to white-yellow. Head with rather many hairs; abdominal tergites rather densely hairy with marginal bristles. Head almost circular; cephalic sutures distinct; fontanelle indistinct; clypeus shorter than half its width; mandibular condyles large. Antennae 14-segmented: segment 3 longer than segment 2; segment 4 about equal to segment 2; segment 5 longer. Pronotum only very weakly concave in the middle.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Tipuani, Bolivia; the type specimen is held in the Hamburg Museum.
